question: What is the admission process for B.E.?
variations: how can i join gce tirunelveli
answer: B.E. (undergraduate) admission is through TNEA counselling. Register on the TNEA portal (usually May-June), upload your 10th/12th mark sheets and certificates, wait for the merit list from Anna University/DOTE, attend single-window counselling with your college and branch preferences, then report to GCE-TLY with original documents to confirm your seat.

question: Is lateral entry available?
variations: can diploma students join directly second year
answer: Yes. Lateral entry is available for candidates with a Diploma or B.Sc background, admitting them directly into the second year of the B.E. program. A B.E. Lateral Entry Admission Notice for 2026-27 was published on 22 July.

question: What is the M.E. (PG) admission process?
answer: M.E. admission goes through GATE/TANCET via CEAP (Common Engineering Admission Procedure): apply online on the Anna University/CFA portal, merit lists are prepared discipline-wise from GATE/TANCET scores, then counselling and single-window seat allotment follow.

question: Is Part-Time B.E. available for working professionals?
variations: can working people study be here
answer: Yes. Part-Time B.E. is offered for working professionals with evening/weekend classes. You need a 3-year Diploma in Engineering plus at least 2 years of relevant work experience in Tamil Nadu. There's no entrance exam -- selection is based purely on your Diploma aggregate marks, and you'll need an employment certificate and NOC from your employer.

question: What documents are required for admission?
answer: For UG (TNEA): 10th and 12th mark sheets, plus category/nativity certificates if applicable, transfer certificate, and photos. For Part-Time B.E.: Diploma mark sheets/certificate, transfer & conduct certificates, an employment certificate showing 2+ years of experience, and an NOC from your employer, plus community/nativity certificates if applicable. Bring originals for verification at counselling/reporting.

question: What is the fee refund policy?
variations: can i get my fee back
answer: Full or partial refund is possible before classes commence (minus processing charges), with eligibility reducing progressively after classes begin. Security deposits are generally refundable on successful completion or proper withdrawal, minus any deductions for damages/dues. Refund processing typically takes 30-60 days from an approved application.

question: Are scholarships available?
answer: The admissions page states scholarships are available for eligible students, though GCE-TLY doesn't have one dedicated scholarships page with fixed amounts as of my last check. There's a Library SC/ST Book Bank for Government of India post-metric scholarship recipients (needs a Principal's-office eligibility certificate). For national schemes, the Government's National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) is the official application route. For GCE-TLY-specific amounts, confirm with the admissions helpdesk.

question: What are the B.E. courses available?
answer: Seven UG (B.E.) programs: Civil Engineering (60 seats), Mechanical Engineering (120), Electrical & Electronics Engineering/EEE (60), Electronics & Communication Engineering/ECE (120), Computer Science & Engineering/CSE (60), Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering (60), and Industrial Biotechnology (60). Total 540 full-time UG seats, plus 300 Part-Time UG seats across Civil, Mechanical, EEE, ECE, and CSE.

question: What are the PG courses available?
answer: Five PG (M.E.) programs, 18 seats each (90 total): Engineering Design, Power Electronics and Drives, Computer Science and Engineering, Structural Engineering, and Communication Systems.

question: Which programs are NBA accredited?
answer: Four UG programs are NBA accredited: Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Electrical and Electronics Engineering.

question: What is the ECE department?
answer: The ECE (Electronics and Communication Engineering) department was established in 1981, has around 19 faculty and 11 PhD holders, and runs labs including DSP, Microprocessor, Microwave & Optical Communication, Digital Communication, and VLSI. Specializations include Communication Systems, VLSI Design, Embedded Systems, IoT, and 5G. Contact: +91-462-2553300, ECE@gcetly.ac.in.

question: Is hostel available for girls?
answer: Yes. There are 3 women's hostels -- Amaravathi, Bhavani, and Narmadha -- with a combined capacity of about 528 students. The Amaravathi Women's Hostel has its own direct line: 0462-2552088.

question: What is the hostel fee?
answer: Total published hostel fee is Rs.14,350/year: Admission Fees Rs.200, Refundable Deposit Rs.5,000, Establishment Charges Rs.3,750, Block Development Charges Rs.3,500, Room Rent Rs.1,000, Electricity Rs.900. The mess (food) bill is separate and billed monthly.

question: What are the hostel timings?
answer: The main gate closes at 9:30 PM daily. Mess timings: Breakfast 8:00-9:00 AM, Lunch 1:00-2:00 PM, Dinner 7:15-8:00 PM, with Study Hours 8:00-10:00 PM and Silent Hours from 10:00 PM to 5:00 AM.

question: How many hostels does the college have?
answer: Seven hostels total: four for men (Chittraru, Kaveri, Porunai, Manimutharu) and three for women (Amaravathi, Bhavani, Narmadha).

question: What are the hostel rules?
variations: can i leave hostel without permission
answer: Key rules: written parental/guardian permission plus warden approval is needed to leave the hostel; ragging is strictly prohibited (dismissal for defaulters); the main gate closes at 9:30 PM; induction stoves, electric cookers, iron boxes and water heaters are prohibited in rooms; all outstanding dues must be cleared before vacating.

question: Tell me about placements.
answer: In the 2025 placement cycle, 212 students were placed across 46 companies (65.6% male, 34.4% female). Department-wise: CSE 48, ECE 51, EEE 28, Civil 20, Mechanical 65. Recruiters included Zoho, Infosys, Bosch, L&T, Renault Nissan, Voltas, Saint Gobain, and Delphi TVS, among 35+ others.

question: What are the library timings?
answer: The Central Library is open Monday-Friday, 10:00 AM - 5:45 PM.

question: How many books can I borrow from the library?
variations: how many books can i issue
answer: Up to 6 books per student, for a 30-day loan period, with up to 2 consecutive renewals allowed. Reference books are library-use only, and all books must be returned before hall tickets are issued.

question: What facilities are available on campus?
answer: Central facilities include a Co-operative Store, a Canara Bank branch plus a 24-hour ATM, a canteen, an on-campus Post Box, the Innovate TN Lab (a government FAB Lab), and an AICTE Internship Training Programme with government financial support. Plus the Central Library and hostel facilities covered separately.

question: Is there an ATM or bank on campus?
answer: Yes, a Canara Bank branch operates near the Hostel Office (Mon-Sat 10:30 AM-3:30 PM, closed 2nd/4th Saturday), plus a 24-hour ATM at the main entrance.

For exact dates, check the Academic Calendar page directly since it's updated each semester. Contact: academic@gcetly.ac.in, +91-462-2553300.

answer: Exact exam dates are published within each semester's Academic Calendar PDF, which I don't have the fine-grained schedule for beyond confirming that the 2026-27 Odd Semester calendar has been published. Check gcetly.ac.in/academiccalendar.php for the downloadable PDF with specific dates.

question: Tell me about the research activities at GCE-TLY.
variations: what research does the college do
answer: The R&D Cell reports 5 active funded projects (Rs.66.16 lakhs total) and 8 patents filed. Tamilpavai). Research Cell Coordinator: Dr. G. Tamilpaavai. Contact: research@gcetly.ac.in.

question: What student clubs or activities are there?
